create_lasr_feature_extractor: create a LasrFeatureExtractor instance with custom mel filter bank parameters for speech feature extraction
build_mel_weight_matrix: build a mel weight matrix using linear_to_mel_weight_matrix with sample rate and frequency range parameters
extract_fbank_features: extract log-mel spectrogram features from raw audio waveform using _torch_extract_fbank_features
featurize_raw_speech: featurize raw speech audio into input_features and attention_mask tensors for LASR model input
pad_and_batch_speech: pad and batch multiple speech sequences with configurable truncation and attention mask generation
